question: Should the N/M/reachability model and the initial Codex, Claude, and Antigravity rollout in this draft become the approved implementation contract for the quota-planning request?
rationale: The document intentionally defines new user-facing planning semantics and cross-provider rollout policy; correctness of the prose cannot establish whether those product choices are the desired long-term contract.

options.title: Confirm the design baseline
options.body: Approve the N/M/reachability model and provider scope as the starting contract, with implementation proceeding incrementally against the linked product request.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Limit the initial contract to one provider or fewer presentation claims until observed quota-pair data validates the model.

options.title: Revise the product model first
options.body: Return the draft for changes if the headline metric, reachability language, or rollout policy should differ before implementation planning continues.

recommendation.title: Confirm the design baseline
recommendation.body: Approve the N/M/reachability model and provider scope as the starting contract, with implementation proceeding incrementally against the linked product request.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked canonical request cites maintainer direction, and the decision controls cross-provider product semantics rather than a mechanical documentation correction.
